div.div:
The other data registers: the same capture / shift / hold multiplexer and shift register; an update register where the IR code updates one (MAS 6)
DATA 0101, r_dr_data[31:0]: capture r_rdata_hold; update r_wdata[31:0] if !w_busy
STATUS 0110, r_dr_status[2:0]: capture {w_busy, r_resp[1:0]}; no update
CPUDBG 0111, r_dr_cpudbg: capture r_dbgreq; update r_dbgreq
CPUHOLD 1000, r_dr_cpuhold: capture r_cpu_hold; update r_cpu_hold
IDCODE 1110, r_dr_idcode[31:0]: capture 32'h0515_3001; no update
BYPASS 1111 and every other code, r_dr_bypass: capture 1'b0; no update
Reset: r_ir 1110, r_addr 0, r_wdata 0, r_dbgreq 0, r_cpu_hold 1
